card.name: Just before cancer or tumor words
card.fires_on: Words right before a cancer term is expected, such as the 'ine' in 'antineoplastic' or 'of' in 'chemotherapy of this disease'. It fires in drug-label text on chemotherapy, malignancy and anti-cancer drug wording.

modes.label: Inside antineoplastic
modes.description: The middle of 'antineoplastic' (ant-ine-oplastic) in drug class lists.

modes.label: Linking word before malignancy
modes.description: A small word like 'of' or 'other' in a chemotherapy or malignancy heading, where a cancer word comes next.
modes.example: WARNING: POST-TRANSPLANT LYMPHOPROLIFERATIVE DISORDER,<< OTHER>> MALIGNANCIES, AND SERIOUS

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict cancer, tumor and oncology words next.
card.plain: It lights up when the text is about to name cancer or anti-cancer drugs.
